playbookOutputs: SARS Customs clearing agent licence (customs client code with agent licence type) issued via RLA
RLA approval notification and bond/security acceptance
Note on licensee obligations (annual licence renewal, security, record keeping, agent code use on declarations)
playbookCommonFailures: No active registered representative or unverifiable cell number on the entity's SARS profile — RLA rejects the application
Customs bond/security (bank guarantee or insurance surety in the SARS-prescribed form) not in place or for an amount SARS considers inadequate
Certified director IDs older than 3 months or a director missing from the pack
Tax compliance status not in good standing at the time of RLA submission
Premises proof is a P.O. Box / virtual office; Customs requires physical business premises and may inspect them

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Documents (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the official CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate of the clearing agent company.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and active directors of the applicant clearing agent.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Active Directors / Members (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) for every director on the CoR 14.3.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Business Premises (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of the physical business premises (< 3 months) in the company name (no P.O. Box or virtual office).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the PHYSICAL business premises dated within 3 months, in the entity name. Customs may inspect the premises; a P.O. Box or virtual office is not accepted.

informationToProvide.label: Valid Bank Confirmation Letter (In the Company Name, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official stamped or QR-verified bank confirmation letter in the company name (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official Bank Account Confirmation Letter from a registered South African bank in the COMPANY name dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Proposed Customs Bond / Security Arrangements (Bank Guarantee or Insurance Surety Undertaking)
alternatives: Insurance surety bond or insurer quotation
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your bank guarantee / insurance surety bond or provisional insurer quotation, and specify the ports/places of entry where you will clear goods.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank guarantee or insurance surety in favour of SARS Customs, or the insurer quotation/undertaking, showing the amount and the entity name.

informationToProvide.label: Verifiable Cellphone Number Linked to SARS Profile & Proof (Cellphone Invoice, Sworn Affidavit, or Request for Accountant Letter)
alternatives: Commissioned affidavit confirming the cellphone number
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a cellphone invoice or commissioned affidavit tying the cellphone number on SARS Registered Details to the company/representative.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Cellphone contract/invoice, commissioned affidavit, or accountant letter confirming the cellphone number on SARS Registered Details.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect licence application documents and security details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads received, bond/security details and premises details captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why Customs needs it. Explain that a clearing agent licence needs security (bank guarantee or insurance bond) in SARS's favour and that SARS sets the amount; ask who their bank/insurer is. Also ask for the customs client codes of any existing importer/exporter registrations, and the names of staff who will lodge declarations. Do not promise faster than 1-2 working days for our submission — Customs approval and security acceptance take longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check registered representative, cell number and compliance status on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Active registered representative confirmed; cell number on SARS Registered Details matches the one supplied; TCS Compliant
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Under SARS Registered Details confirm: (1) registered representative active — if not, stop and propose the Tax Representative Appointment service; (2) cell number on the profile equals the number supplied — if not, RAV01 contact details must be updated first (OTP; hand off to Kevin); (3) Tax Compliance Status Compliant — if not, draft a client message listing what is outstanding. Never attempt OTP or CAPTCHA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against Customs licensing requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; every director has a certified ID; security document names SARS and the entity
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the applicant company. Cross-check directors on the CoR14.3 against certified IDs. Bank letter, premises proof and security must be in the company's name. If the security is only a quotation, note that SARS will issue the required amount after assessment and the final bond must be lodged before the licence issues.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare RLA clearing agent licence hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every RLA field value and upload list posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fields (RLA licence type 'Clearing agent' — the DA185 + DA185.4B7 equivalent; ⚠ verify annexure number): applicant details, tax and VAT numbers, physical premises, directors, contact person and cell, bank details, security type and amount, ports/places of entry at which they will operate, existing customs codes, staff authorised to lodge declarations. Fill from verified facts only; leave unknowns blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit clearing agent licence application on eFiling RLA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: RLA application staged with all documents attached; Kevin submits and the RLA reference number is recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: eFiling > Customs > Registration Licensing and Accreditation (RLA) > New Application > Licence type 'Clearing agent' (⚠ verify current menu names). Stage all values, attach: CoR14.3, certified director IDs, bank letter, premises proof, security document, cell-number proof. Screenshot each screen and stop for Kevin to submit. Record the reference number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for Customs assessment, security acceptance and licence issue
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Licence issued on RLA / approval notification received, or SARS security determination received and actioned
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the RLA dashboard at each follow-up. Customs commonly responds with the security amount required or a premises inspection; create a proposal for Kevin and a plain client message with what is needed (e.g. lodge bank guarantee for R x). Escalate via the Customs contact centre with the reference number if no movement by day 10.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver licence and obligations note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Licence, customs code and guidance posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain: the licence must be renewed annually (⚠ verify renewal cycle and fee), the security must stay in force, declarations must carry the agent code, and records are kept for 5 years. Offer the importer/exporter registrations for their own clients.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
